title: Banana Bites
description: Half banana bread, half flapjack — these bite-sized treats are made from mashed bananas, rolled oats and raisins. Healthy and comfortingly squidgy.
steps: Mash the bananas in a bowl until they form a gooey thick liquid. Stir in the rolled oats and raisins, mixing thoroughly.
Arrange heaped teaspoonfuls of the mixture in rows around 2cm apart on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes until just turning golden brown. If using two baking sheets, swap them halfway through.
Allow to cool on the baking sheet before prising off. Serve in paper petit-four cases.
notes: Makes around 26 bites. Per bite estimate. Keep for several days in a tin.
